notes.title: The next title GIRLS MADE PUDDING - Coming this Spring!
notes.notes:
The next work in the project by Kazuhide Oka × KAMITSUBAKI STUDIO, ANMC, is the girl-talk touring ADV GIRLS MADE PUDDING. It will be released this spring on Nintendo Switch & Steam.

Check out the latest trailer revealing the new key visual and character models.

[previewyoutube=FDe1uIia2hI;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Our next title, "GIRLS MADE PUDDING" has been announced!
notes.notes:
ANMC, a collaborative project of Kazuhide Oka and KAMITSUBAKI STUDIO,
has announced "GIRLS MADE PUDDING", a Girls Talk & Touring Adventure Game.

In the game, you will traverse a world where its inhabitants have vanished, in search of the nostalgic taste of pudding.

Add this game to your Wishlist and wait for further updates!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3337210/_/

notes.title: Video & Image Sharing Guidelines
notes.notes:
Please adhere to the following guidelines when posting gameplay videos and images
related to the full version of "Moonless Moon".
[list]
[*]Do not use excessive editing or processing that prevents others from correctly grasping the content of the game.
[*]Do not extract individual elements included in this game, such as background music or character images.
[*]Do not redistribute for profit. However, the normal monetization of videos on sites like YouTube is allowed.
[*]Do not combine it with content that is contrary to public order and morals, or combine it with illegal information.
[*]Do not make posts that include modifications to this game, data mining results, etc.
[*]Do not reprint videos or screenshots created by third parties without permission.
[/list]
This game includes songs managed by JASRAC and NexTone, so you may receive a notice of a copyright claim
if you post a video that contains these songs on YouTube.
However, as long as you adhere to our guidelines, you do not need to delete the video.

*These guidelines may be updated at any time without notice.
Please check here for the latest version of these guidelines before you post content.

notes.title: "Moonless Moon" Now Available on Steam!
notes.notes:
We are excited to announce that "Moonless Moon" is now available on Steam.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2951340/_/

Additionally, we are offering a 5% discount on a bundle that includes the BGM when purchased together.
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/43986/Moonless_Moon__BGM_Bundle/

[previewyoutube=QVSHi71NQBM;full][/previewyoutube]

Yomichi is a normal girl living an average student's life—except for one thing: sometimes, after sunset, she finds herself transported into worlds that seem unreal. Be it a desert on the moon, a coffee shop inside of a tunnel, or an island in the sky, she enjoys her time in these new places, making friends each time. However, this leaves her with some questions. 

Enjoy the game!

notes.title: Demo available during Steam Next Fest!
notes.notes:
Moonless Moon, set for release in 2024, will be participating in the Steam Next Fest, starting on June 10th 10:00 (PT).

The demo will be playable on both Windows and Mac, and you'll be able to play through the prologue section of the game.

Please look forward to trying out the demo!
